security_spec.violation_condition: In QEMU TCG or KVM-accelerated emulation, when PMP is enabled with configured rules, an M-mode data access that partially falls within a PMP entry (matching only start or end bytes but not all bytes) is not universally rejected: the partial-match check at pmp.c:413 returns false, but if this check is bypassed (e.g., during page-table walks with effective privilege mode M, or via a TCG fast-path that skips PMP for M-mode load/store when mstatus.MPRV=0), M-mode can read or write memory that spans PMP region boundaries, violating the clarified rule that PMP matching enforcement supersedes the 'optional M-mode' clause.
security_spec.vulnerability_pattern: mode == PRV_M && !pmp_is_locked && allowed_privs unchanged; or M-mode load/store path without pmp_hart_has_privs call; or get_physical_address_pmp skipped for M-mode mmu-translated page walks
security_spec.summary: PMP partial-match denial must apply to M-mode accesses unconditionally; QEMU's unlocked-M-mode full-access shortcut (pmp.c:434-436) must not allow M-mode to read/write across PMP region boundaries that should reject the access at matching granularity
